item.raw_source:
import Mathlib
open Polynomial Filter Topology Real Set Nat List

/--
Suppose that $G$ is a finite group generated by the two elements $g$ and $h$, where the order of $g$ is odd. Show that every element of $G$ can be written in the form
\[
g^{m_1} h^{n_1} g^{m_2} h^{n_2} \cdots g^{m_r} h^{n_r}
\]
with $1 \leq r \leq |G|$ and $m_1, n_1, m_2, n_2, \ldots, m_r, n_r \in \{-1, 1\}$.
(Here $|G|$ is the number of elements of $G$.)
-/
theorem S03
(G : Type*) [Group G]
(Gfin : Fintype G)
(g h : G)
(ghgen : Subgroup.closure {g, h} = ⊤ ∧ ¬Subgroup.closure {g} = ⊤ ∧ ¬Subgroup.closure {h} = ⊤)
(godd : Odd (orderOf g))
(S : Set G)
(hS : S = {g * h, g⁻¹ * h, g * h⁻¹, g⁻¹ * h⁻¹})
: (∀ x : G, ∃ mn : List G, 1 ≤ mn.length ∧ mn.length ≤ Gfin.card ∧ ∀ i : Fin mn.length, mn.get i ∈ S ∧ x = List.prod mn) :=
sorry

probe.proof:
by
  let G := Multiplicative (ZMod 1)
  have ht (s : Set G) : Subgroup.closure s = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    have he : x = 1 := Subsingleton.elim x 1
    simpa [he]
  refine ⟨G, inferInstance, inferInstance, 1, 1, {1}, ⟨ht _, by simp, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact h.1.2.1 (ht _)

probe.proof:
by
  let G := Multiplicative (ZMod 1)
  let S : Set G := {(1 : G) * 1, 1⁻¹ * 1, 1 * 1⁻¹, 1⁻¹ * 1⁻¹}
  have ht (s : Set G) : Subgroup.closure s = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    have he : x = 1 := Subsingleton.elim x 1
    rw [he]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  refine ⟨G, inferInstance, inferInstance, 1, 1, S, ⟨ht _, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [orderOf_one]
    exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · intro h
    exact h.1.2.1 (ht _)
